translation.name: Kitap molinas men ringkat na alaata'ala: perjanjian baru

content: Petrus nompotuutuu' nansaranianna i Kornelius na Yerusalem
Ari poposuu' tia mian men parasaya ni Yesus na longkop Yudea, nongorongor se' mian men taasi' Yahudi uga' namarasayamo wurungna Alaata'ala.
Sarataa i Petrus nomae' na Yerusalem, samba Yahudi men noparasayamo ni Yesus iya'a, nompoposala'mo i Petrus.
Taena i raaya'a, “Nongko'upa i kuu se' mae' na laiganna mian men taasi' Yahudi, men sianpo nisunat? Kuu tamban kumaan singka-singkat tii raaya'a!”
Ya'a mbali' i Petrus nuntundunkonmo na ko'ona i raaya'a giigii' kakalianganna upa men nosida tumbenapo. Taeni Petrus,

“Yaku' pintanga' sambayang na kota Yope, kasi i yaku' nosimpalaalungon. Yaku' nimiile' isian upa men koi sa'angu' toik bambal ni'ulul nda'amari langit, loe-loe nikoot na papaat susuna, ka' notaan na aropku.
Pintanga' i yaku' mamakanasai lalomna, ola-olan yaku' nimiile' ayop men papaat a saratna, ayop men malela', ayop men sumondur tia sapu' men malela'.
Kasi yaku' nongorongor wurung men koi kani'imari, ‘Alaka' wangon, Petrus! Pongkoyo' ka' pangkaan!’
Kasee yaku' simbati taengku', ‘Sian, Tumpu! Yaku' sianpo nontoo kaan kakaan men sian sida kaanon koi na ukum Torat.’
Kasee yaku' rongor soosoodo a wurung men nda'amari surugaa taena, ‘Upa men ia ngaanmo Alaata'ala se' sida kaanon, alia i koo mangaan se' sian sida kaanon ka' kobiit.’
Yaku' nimiile' men koiya'a koi porotolu. Ka' komburi'na notonakatmo mbaara'a na surugaa.
Tempopo iya'a tolu' mian men ringkat na Kaisarea, men niposuu' mondolo' i yaku' notakamo na laigan men nintundaanku.

Kasi Alus Molinas nomosuu' i yaku' mae' poololo' tii raaya'a, tia sian bata-bata. Mian men noom ira karaaya'a, tempo iya'a uga' nolumolo' tii yaku' mae' na Kaisarea, ka' i kai giigii' ninsoop na laigan ni Kornelius.

Kasi i Kornelius nuntundunkon na ko'omai koi upa i ia nimiile' sa'angu' malaa'ikat nokumekerer na laiganna ka' norobu taena, ‘Posuu' a mian mae' na kota Yope mengeleelo' sa'angu' mian men ngaanon i Simon Petrus.
Ia bo mantadulkon lele men mansalamatkon i kuu sangkau laigan.’
Ka' baasi muntumbei morobu i yaku', Alus Molinas niminsoopimo i raaya'a koi men tumbena nosida na ko'onta' mbaripian.
Kasi i yaku' notonginau', se' Tumpu isian norobu koi kani'imari: ‘Yohanes mansarani tia weer, kasee i kuu bo saranionna Alaata'ala tia Alus Molinas.’

Mbaka' manasamo se' Alaata'ala uga' mongorookon barakaat na mian men taasi' Yahudi iya'a, koikoimo men Ia rookon i kita, tempo i kita noparasaya ni Tumpu Yesus Kristus. Kalu koiya'a, se' sida mbali' i yaku' mantalantangi Alaata'ala?”

Sarataa nongorongor men koiya'a, raaya'a sianmo nanggagai soosoodo. Raaya'a nuntunde' Alaata'ala, kasi taena i raaya'a, “Kalu koiya'a, mian men taasi' Yahudi uga' ia tarai Alaata'ala tempo bo monsosoli ka' mangkadarai wawauna men ba'idek!”
Jama'at na Antiokhia

Kasee sarataa i Stefanus nipapatei, mian men parasaya ni Yesus nipoototorapikon, pataka i raaya'a somo nobasia-siak waale'e-le'emari. Isian men namarere na lipu' Fenisia, ka' isian uga' men tadul na togong Siprus tia na kota Antiokhia. Mau ne' i raaya'a mengelelekon lele ni Yesus tongko' na samba Yahudi.
Kasee isian mian men parasaya ni Yesus men ringkat na Siprus tia Kirene. Raaya'a a men nomae' na Antiokhia nengelelekon Lele Pore men ringkat ni Yesus na samba Yunani.
Kuasana Tumpu isian na ko'ona i raaya'a, mbali' biai' a mian men noparasayamo ka' nongorookon wakana i raaya'a na Tumpu.
Lele iya'a uga' notadulmo na jama'at Yerusalem. Mbaka' i raaya'a nomosuu'mo i Barnabas mae' na Antiokhia.

Ka' sarataa i Barnabas notaka na Antiokhia ka' nimiile' se' koi upa a barakaatna Alaata'ala na mian biai' iya'a, ia nobelesmo tuu'. Kasi ia nama'ase' kada' i raaya'a sida malolo' na Tumpu tia noa men tuutuu'.
Gause i Barnabas kani'i mian men ma'amat a noana ka' kuasaionna Alus Molinas, ka' i ia parasaya tuu' na Tumpu, mbaka' nokanturanganmo biai' a mian men nongololo' Tumpu.
Kasi i Barnabas nomae' na Tarsus nansarak i Saulus.

Sarataa nopootuung tii Saulus, ia nangawawamo i Saulus mae' na Antiokhia. Raaya'a koi sa'angu' taun a nau'na nodumodongo tia jama'at na Antiokhia, ka' nimisiso' mian biai'. Na Antiokhiamo iya'a a tumbena mian men malolo' ni Yesus ningaan mian Sarani.
Tempo iya'a isian toro pii nabii men ringkat na Yerusalem notaka na Antiokhia.

Isian sa'angu' nabii iya'a, ngaanna i Agabus. Alus Molinas namatana' i ia mambantilkon se' na longkop tano' balaki' bo takaionna pololuan men dodoa tuu'. (Ka' men koiya'a uga' nosida na tempo batomundo'an ni Kaisar Klaudius.)
Mbaka' mian men malolo' ni Yesus nosangadamo mantarai ruru'anna bona utus sa'angu' kaparasaya'an men dumodongo na Yudea; sanda' mian mungururu' koi men pokoonna.
Ka' sangadaan iya'a uga' ia limangmo i raaya'a, kasi i Barnabas tii Saulus niposuu' mangator ruru'anna i raaya'a na penatuana jama'at.
